mapper.select: select up.utility_provider_no , nvl(up.apt_cmplex_no, p.apt_cmplex_no) as apt_cmplex_no , p.partner_no , up.csv_idntf_key , up.ext_cust_no , up.meter_ty_cd , meter_ty.code_name as meter_ty_nm , up.rmrk_cn , p.partner_nm , fc.cont_no as cont_no , fc.cont_nm , fc.cont_cn , to_char(fc.cont_bgng_dt, 'yyyy.mm.dd') as cont_bgng_dt , to_char(fc.cont_end_dt, 'yyyy.mm.dd') as cont_end_dt from facility_contract fc inner join partner p on fc.partner_no = p.partner_no left join utility_provider up on up.cont_no = fc.cont_no and up.apt_cmplex_no = #{aptCmplexNo} left join common_code meter_ty on up.meter_ty_cd = meter_ty.code_no_cd and meter_ty.group_code_no = 'METER_TY' where p.apt_cmplex_no = #{aptCmplexNo} and ( fc.cont_ty_cd = 'METER' or fc.cont_target_cd = 'METER' or instr(nvl(fc.cont_nm, ''), '검침') > 0 or instr(nvl(fc.cont_cn, ''), '검침') > 0 or up.utility_provider_no is not null ) and nvl(fc.cont_stts_cd, 'ING') not in ('EXP', 'CNL', 'TERMINATE', 'END') order by fc.cont_bgng_dt desc , fc.cont_no desc

select up.utility_provider_no , up.apt_cmplex_no , up.partner_no , up.csv_idntf_key , up.ext_cust_no , up.meter_ty_cd , meter_ty.code_name as meter_ty_nm , up.cont_no , up.rmrk_cn , p.partner_nm from utility_provider up left join partner p on up.partner_no = p.partner_no left join common_code meter_ty on up.meter_ty_cd = meter_ty.code_no_cd and meter_ty.group_code_no = 'METER_TY' where up.apt_cmplex_no = #{aptCmplexNo} and up.utility_provider_no = #{utilityProviderNo}

select code_no_cd as "codeNoCd" , code_name as "codeName" , code_content as "codeContent" , sort_order as "sortOrder" from common_code where group_code_no = 'METER_RSLT' and use_yn = 'Y' order by sort_order

select code_no_cd as "codeNoCd" , code_name as "codeName" , code_content as "codeContent" , sort_order as "sortOrder" from common_code where group_code_no = 'METER_TY' and use_yn = 'Y' order by sort_order
select count(*) from common_code where group_code_no = 'METER_RSLT' and code_no_cd = #{meterRsltCd} and use_yn = 'Y'

select f.facility_no , f.facility_nm , f.facility_ty_cd , fac_ty.code_name as facility_ty_nm , f.loc_cn , f.dong_no from facility f left join common_code fac_ty on f.facility_ty_cd = fac_ty.code_no_cd and fac_ty.group_code_no = 'FACILITY_TY' where f.apt_cmplex_no = #{aptCmplexNo} and f.facility_no = #{facilityNo}

select distinct regexp_substr(mh.ho_no, '[^_]+', 1, 2) as "dongNo" from meter_hstry mh inner join utility_provider up on mh.utility_provider_no = up.utility_provider_no where up.apt_cmplex_no = #{aptCmplexNo} and mh.ho_no is not null and regexp_substr(mh.ho_no, '[^_]+', 1, 2) is not null order by to_number(regexp_substr(mh.ho_no, '[^_]+', 1, 2))

select * from ( select distinct regexp_substr(mh.ho_no, '[^_]+', 1, 2) as "dongNo" , regexp_substr(mh.ho_no, '[^_]+', 1, 3) as "hoNo" from meter_hstry mh inner join utility_provider up on mh.utility_provider_no = up.utility_provider_no where up.apt_cmplex_no = #{aptCmplexNo} and mh.ho_no is not null
and regexp_substr(mh.ho_no, '[^_]+', 1, 2) = #{dongNo}
and regexp_substr(mh.ho_no, '[^_]+', 1, 3) like #{keyword} || '%'
order by to_number(regexp_substr(mh.ho_no, '[^_]+', 1, 3)) ) where rownum <= 30

select mh.meter_hstry_no , mh.facility_no , f.facility_nm , f.facility_ty_cd , fac_ty.code_name as facility_ty_nm , f.dong_no , f.loc_cn , mh.ho_no , mh.meter_dt , mh.pre_val , mh.curr_val , mh.meter_cn , mh.meter_rslt_cd , rslt.code_name as meter_rslt_nm , mh.reg_dt , mh.mdf_dt , up.utility_provider_no , up.meter_ty_cd , meter_ty.code_name as meter_ty_nm , p.partner_no , p.partner_nm , fc.cont_no , fc.cont_nm , p.pic_nm , p.pic_telno , p.pic_email from meter_hstry mh left join facility f on mh.facility_no = f.facility_no left join common_code fac_ty on f.facility_ty_cd = fac_ty.code_no_cd and fac_ty.group_code_no = 'FACILITY_TY' left join utility_provider up on mh.utility_provider_no = up.utility_provider_no left join partner p on up.partner_no = p.partner_no left join facility_contract fc on up.cont_no = fc.cont_no left join common_code meter_ty on up.meter_ty_cd = meter_ty.code_no_cd and meter_ty.group_code_no = 'METER_TY' left join common_code rslt on mh.meter_rslt_cd = rslt.code_no_cd and rslt.group_code_no = 'METER_RSLT' where mh.meter_hstry_no = #{meterHstryNo}
